--CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW real_assets_portfolio_listed AS
WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
private_real_estate_model_portfolios AS ( -- "private" model portoflios that are actually part of listed portfolio 
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Private Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND mp.model_portfolio_id IN  ('RIALIA02', 'RIFLAM', 'RIESRKS', 'RIRELCP', 'RIUNITE')
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT *
       FROM private_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT *

           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date

       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'

             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)

      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'

--CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW real_assets_portfolio_listed AS
WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
private_real_estate_model_portfolios AS ( -- "private" model portoflios that are actually part of listed portfolio 
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Private Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND mp.model_portfolio_id IN  ('RIALIA02', 'RIFLAM', 'RIESRKS', 'RIRELCP', 'RIUNITE')
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'

       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp

      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'

       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif

         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'

        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'

              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'

        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)

       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'

                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')

                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)

SELECT
	from_currency
	,to_currency
	,mid_price
	,business_date
	,inverse_quoted
FROM
(
	SELECT
		from_currency
		,to_currency
		,CASE
			WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
			ELSE mid_price
		END as mid_price
		,business_date
		,'N' as inverse_quoted
	FROM
		"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
	WHERE
		(
			(rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='USD'
			AND to_currency IN ('AED','ARS','AUD','BMD','BRL','BSD','CAD','CHF','CLP','CNH','CNY','COP','CZK','DKK','EGP','EUR','GBP','GHS','HKD','HRK','HUF','IDR','ILS','INR','JPY','KRW','KYD','MAD','MXN','MYR','NGN','NOK','NZD','PAB','PEN','PHP','PLN','RON','RUB','SEK','SGD','THB','TRY','TWD','UAH','VND','ZAR')
		)
		OR
			(rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='GBP'
			AND to_currency IN ('EUR'))
		)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		t_usdrates.to_currency as from_currency
		,t_usdcadrate.to_currency
		,t_usdcadrate.mid_price/t_usdrates.mid_price as mid_price
		,t_usdcadrate.business_date
		,t_usdcadrate.inverse_quoted
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
			from_currency
			,to_currency
			,CASE
				WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
				ELSE mid_price
			END as mid_price
			,business_date
			,'N' as inverse_quoted
		FROM
			"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
		WHERE
			rate_type_code = 'SR'
			AND from_currency = 'USD'
			AND to_currency = 'CAD'
	) t_usdcadrate
	INNER JOIN
	(
		SELECT
			from_currency
			,to_currency
			,CASE
				WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
				ELSE mid_price
			END as mid_price
			,business_date
			,'N' as inverse_quoted
		FROM
			"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
		WHERE

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','UAH','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','AZN','BYN','ZWG')
								AND erc.data_date BETWEEN to_date('2009-05-24', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
								AND to_date('2025-06-10', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
								AND (erd.exchange_rate is not NULL OR erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag = 1)
						)
					)
			    )
        WHERE currencyToUsdRate is not NULL
        OR currencyToCadRate is not Null
        ORDER BY date

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 10
		AND hour between 01 and 02
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10 01:16:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

                t.total_attribution
       FROM alternative_assets_dev.listed_real_assets_bloomberg_attribution_by_sector as t

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-08')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-08')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT

    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",

    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",

    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-08')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-08')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-08')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-08')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

    lth.currency_of_exposure_code AS "currency_of_exposure_name_current",

    mh.clean_price * mh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS "clean_price_pc",
    mh.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS "clean_value_pc",
    lth.total_market_value_pc AS "total_market_value_pc",
    (mh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency + 
     mh.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + 
     mh.next_dividend_quotation_currency + 
     mh.next_coupon_quotation_currency + 
     mh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency) * 
     mh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS "total_accrued_income_pc",
    mh.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS "balance_cost_value_pc",
    lth.total_market_value_qc AS "total_market_value_qc",
    mh.clean_price AS "clean_price_qc",
    mh.clean_value_quotation_currency AS "clean_value_qc",
    (mh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency + 
     mh.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + 
     mh.next_dividend_quotation_currency + 
     mh.next_coupon_quotation_currency + 
     mh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency) AS "total_accrued_income_qc",
    mh.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency AS "balance_cost_value_qc",
    mh.scd_holding_key_id AS "holding_key_ik",
    lth.pool_name AS "pool",
    lth.total_market_value_pc * uacpp.unitized_percentage AS "acpp_total_market_value_pc",
    lth.total_market_value_pc * ubcpp.unitized_percentage AS "bcpp_total_market_value_pc"
FROM holdings_dev.scd_holdings_main mh
LEFT JOIN holdings_dev.ma_holding_lookthrough lth 
    ON lth.parent_holding_key = mh.scd_holding_key_id 
    AND DATE(mh.business_date) = lth.business_date
LEFT JOIN latest_enterprise_security s 
    ON s.enterprise_security_id = lth.parent_enterprise_security_id 
LEFT JOIN latest_enterprise_security underlying 
    ON CAST(underlying.scd_security_key_id AS VARCHAR) = s.esm_underlying_instrument_id
LEFT JOIN latest_enterprise_security s_no

LEFT JOIN reference_dev.scd_model_portfolio mp 
    ON mh.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id

LEFT JOIN reference_dev.scd_portfolio sp

    AND sp.business_date = mh.business_date
LEFT JOIN finance_accounting_dev.scd_unitization uacpp 
    ON mp.pool_account_code = uacpp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
    AND uacpp.acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP'

    AND ubcpp.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN latest_performance_invstr_flatten pif 
    ON lth.id_model_portfolio = pif.model_portfolio) AS "New custom SQL"

	GROUP BY

		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

/* cppi::0a10b1250d9a234762f61a175fe4a3d6bcc842b8e35a85e5159f3be74d63c496 */
/* QuickSight 6555b93d-31ca-46c2-9c10-f3eac6e66939 */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em

		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "holdings_lookthrough_new"

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 10
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10 17:31:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::4b8a3f2016f1b9a4af55501284ec1a53f05f6247ae39d1c3d1d341afe6314741 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-08')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-08')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-08')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

/* cppi::1620f76b7679c68b74b63659b130c188256152b0c2d42d9b5030499554414fa4 */
SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
        SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
    ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM account_mapping_query
        UNION
        SELECT
            date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
            '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 JOIN adjusted_date ad ON CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) = ad.business_date

            SELECT 1
            FROM account_mapping_query fq
            WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
              AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
        )) T LIMIT 0

/* cppi::6bc147477a4bdff7938df6a69d53845e50294fb3c932563c07c899851810b3ab */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 10
		AND hour between 07 and 08
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-10 07:10:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000
